mentions.name: rkvdns (DNS gateway for Redis)
mentions.description: A Python product that implements a DNS gateway for Redis, with built-in observability for debugging coroutines/threading: coroutine state is exposed as DNS TXT records (e.g., write_control, get, statistics_report, process_pending_queue counters) queryable via dig.
mentions.problem: Debugging co-routines / threading is a pain in any language.
